subject.title: Use shared Spark subscription review rails

question: Should Template Store authorize CLAWSWEEPER_DISPATCH_TOKEN to be passed to the pinned shared Spark relay when CLAWSWEEPER_SPARK_ENABLED is enabled?
rationale: The change intentionally moves review execution and a repository secret across a reusable-workflow boundary; only repository owners can accept that trust relationship.

options.title: Approve after evidence
options.body: Approve the relay after reviewing the pinned workflow's secret handling and obtaining a successful exact-head Store verification run.

options.title: Keep local execution
options.body: Retain the local caller workflow if the repository should not delegate this secret-bearing review path.

recommendation.title: Approve after evidence
recommendation.body: Approve the relay after reviewing the pinned workflow's secret handling and obtaining a successful exact-head Store verification run.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent dispatch-proof branch is the closest available repository-history signal for the workflow area.
